business_summary: Eaton Vance Municipal Income 2028 Term Trust is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched and managed by Eaton Vance Management. It invests in the fixed income markets. The fund invest in stocks of companies operating across the diversified sectors. It was previously known as Eaton Vance Municipal Income Term Trust. Eaton Vance Municipal Income 2028 Term Trust was formed on March 28, 2013 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Eaton Vance Municipal Income 2028 Term Trust는 Eaton Vance Management가 출시하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 다양한 부문에 걸쳐 운영되는 회사의 주식에 투자합니다. 이전에는 Eaton Vance Municipal Income Term Trust로 알려졌습니다. Eaton Vance Municipal Income 2028 Term Trust는 2013년 3월 28일에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
